items.title: 12.11 The theories about the forces between the masses of particles

source_refs.note: Topic 12.11 as printed (PDF 275-276, printed 272-273): both theories under their printed headings (both numbered 2.) and the For Your Information picture of the scale of matter.

blocks.text: To explain the interactions between the masses of the particles through different mediators, we have the following two theories, the quantum field theory and the string theory.
